evals.name: pulls-stats-endpoint
evals.prompt: Додай ендпоінт GET /pulls/:id/stats у server: кількість змінених файлів, сумарні additions/deletions і кількість findings по severity (по останньому ревʼю кожного агента). Контракт поклади в @devdigest/shared.
evals.expected_output: Thin route; SQL in a repository; orchestration in a service with explicit deps; severity/sum math in a pure helper with a unit test; contract in shared (+ client copy); no drizzle in routes/services.
assertions: Contract added in server @devdigest/shared
Contract mirrored into client vendor/shared
Query lives in a repository file
Hermetic unit test for the pure stats/severity math
Orchestration in a service.ts
No new Drizzle/db-schema usage outside repositories
No SDK import or raw fetch() outside src/adapters
New code does not use Container as a service locator (ctor param or this.container.x)
No Fastify types/imports in services, repositories or domain files

evals.name: pr-refresh-to-service
evals.prompt: GET /pulls/:id в server/src/modules/pulls/routes.ts сам ходить у GitHub і перезаписує prFiles/prCommits окремими запитами. Винеси цю логіку з роута в нормальне місце, щоб оновлення файлів і комітів було атомарним.
evals.expected_output: PullsService.refreshDetail (or similar) with explicit deps; repository method doing delete+insert of files and commits in ONE db.transaction; GitHub fetch happens before/outside the transaction; route becomes thin; Tx/DbExecutor type added.
assertions: Adds a db.transaction for the files+commits rewrite
Transaction lives in a repository file
No GitHub/network call inside the transaction
prFiles/prCommits writes removed from pulls/routes.ts
Introduces a Tx/DbExecutor type (no Drizzle leak to service)
No new Drizzle/db-schema usage outside repositories
No SDK import or raw fetch() outside src/adapters
New code does not use Container as a service locator (ctor param or this.container.x)
No Fastify types/imports in services, repositories or domain files

evals.name: slack-notification-integration
evals.prompt: Хочу після завершення review run відправляти повідомлення в Slack через incoming webhook (URL зберігається як секрет SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL). Зроби це.
evals.expected_output: Port interface (e.g. Notifier) in vendor/shared/adapters.ts; adapter under src/adapters/<port>/ with the HTTP call; lazy container getter reading the secret via SecretsProvider + ContainerOverrides entry; mock in adapters/mocks.ts; run-executor/service depends on the port type only; failure does not break the run.
assertions: Port interface added in vendor/shared/adapters.ts
Adapter implementation under src/adapters/<port>/
Mock added to adapters/mocks.ts
Container getter + ContainerOverrides entry
SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL added to SecretKey and read via SecretsProvider (not process.env)
No new Drizzle/db-schema usage outside repositories
No SDK import or raw fetch() outside src/adapters
New code does not use Container as a service locator (ctor param or this.container.x)
No Fastify types/imports in services, repositories or domain files
